observations: Three photos show multiple 3-tier rolling storage racks in different colors: teal, white, pink, and cream.
Each rack has three open trays, a handle at the top, and four caster wheels.
The racks are shown in home settings, loaded with items like fruits, drinks, snacks, and decorative objects.
The racks appear to be made of plastic or coated metal with a smooth finish.
No brand or model markings are visible on any of the racks in the photos.
The watermark 'BISALLURE STORE POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.
The seller describes the item as a '3 tier metal rolling storage rack and salon trolley'.

claims.claim: 3 tier metal rolling storage rack and salon trolley
claims.evidence: The item is clearly a 3-tier rolling storage rack, but the material is not visibly confirmed as metal; it appears to be plastic or coated metal. The 'salon trolley' claim is unverifiable remotely as no salon-specific features (like tools, mirrors, or professional branding) are visible.

risks.risk: Material is not metal as claimed, possibly plastic or coated metal
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rack's frame and tray material showing texture, thickness, and any metal markings or welds.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as plastic or coated metal, which is typically lower than solid metal.

risks.risk: Wheels may be non-locking or poorly constructed, affecting stability and usability
risks.proof: Close-up of the wheels showing locking mechanism, wheel type, and attachment to the frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially unstable or with non-locking wheels, reducing value.

risks.risk: Rack may be damaged or have scratches not visible in current photos
risks.proof: Full 360-degree view or close-up of all sides and corners of the rack.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly used or damaged, lowering value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rack's frame and tray material to verify if it is metal.
Close-up of the wheels to check for locking mechanisms and build quality.
Full 360-degree view of the rack to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 3-tier rolling storage rack, but the material claim (metal) and the 'salon trolley' function cannot be verified from current photos. Hidden risks related to material, wheel quality, and condition affect pricing. Proof is needed to determine the correct value.
